Taxonomy completeness for Web Components, CSS-in-JS donors and donors exposing their own theming API. Schema-representable via mount_topology and conversion, but under-specified. Recorded as a limit, not as proof of completeness.

contradicts_or_extends_inherited: The token-pack science is complete for owned code and silent on donor code — it does not address cross-origin inheritance, scoped bridging, namespace collision or restyling code Actionist does not own. That gap is P07's remit; its own section 6 open question 7 concedes the schema is an engineering derivation, not a standards minimum.

Gate B's literal clause and gate J's literal audit are source-side and cannot substantiate a composition-level coherence claim. Gate J as built reads .css files under src only — not TSX inline styles, not styled-component literals, not compiled donor output, and not a cross-origin surface at all.

The P08 absorb/preserve boundary is substantially a THEMING boundary. The estate's most expensive architectural decision — vendoring a donor grid plus ~30 stub files — was driven by CSS custom properties not inheriting across an origin. P08 owns the shell consequence; P07 owns the cause.

knowledge/06's Design Validity Contract requires 'no undeclared raw style literals in generated code'. For donor surfaces this is unenforceable as written; replaced by declared unstylable surfaces plus runtime gates K-N.

handoff_edges.edge: Theming requirement constrains mount topology; a themeable surface cannot be cross-origin framed. Chrome suppression is jointly owned. A typed theme edit may change pack selection or a declared context offset only — never values, never a binding file. Upgrade replay must consume upgrade_fragility.
ReuseDecision must carry a themeability requirement and a binding_class. A PackagingProfile without mount topology cannot be routed.

binding_class is a feasibility constraint, not a ranking preference. 'Themeable surface + cross-origin-only donor' must eliminate deterministically before model judgment; unknown mount topology returns UNDERDETERMINED.

Gates K-N are runtime observations needing a place in the qualification record. Release manifests must pin pack version together with binding versions. The same-origin proxy question (U-E) is runtime/CSP, not design.

self_challenge.claim: The absorb/preserve boundary is a theming boundary
self_challenge.note: The quoted reason is explicit and contemporaneous, but session coupling is a joint driver and some absorption was placement-motivated. The framework needs only the weaker claim that theming is a feasibility INPUT to reuse shape, which the quote establishes directly.

Non-inheritance across origins is a boundary property, not a limit of effort. X-3 measures the real ceiling rather than assuming it; the same-origin proxy escape is recorded as unknown rather than dismissed.

self_challenge.claim: Gate L catches the encoding trap
self_challenge.note: Must compare against the CONVERTED expected value with tight tolerance, not merely flag large deltas — a near-neutral value could produce a small delta. X-1 plants a deliberate alias to verify the gate rather than trust it.
Web Components, CSS-in-JS and donor theming APIs are schema-representable but under-specified. Recorded as a limit, not as proof of completeness.

smoke_detail: 110 checks. File presence and non-emptiness for all 7 artifacts; JSON validity for all 4 JSON files; semantic-contract shape including that every non-bindable role family states a reason and that nav and shell are host-owned; ledger discipline requiring a falsifier, evidence and at least two options considered per decision; boundary-flag assertions; a sampled-rate honesty check asserting no inherited rate appears without its denominator; 4 positive and 7 negative schema fixtures validated with jsonschema Draft 2020-12; and cross-document link checks. The negative fixtures are load-bearing: they assert the schema actively rejects :root-scoped bindings, aliased encoding mismatches, cross-origin parity claims, cross-origin B3 bindings, B4 claiming stability, observed evidence without a receipt, and B2 without a retokenization record.
negative_fixture_verification: Each negative fixture was confirmed to fail at the intended schema location for the intended reason, not incidentally: N1 at scope/selector (:root pattern), N2 at encoding (alias-across-encodings conditional), N3 at coherence_ceiling (B5 barred from parity), N4 at binding_class and mount_topology (cross-origin forced to B5), N5 at upgrade_fragility (B4 barred from stable), N6 at evidence/0 (observed requires receipt), N7 at root (B2 requires retokenization).
